description: This PHP class 'Prop' in the OrangeHRM project defines a property used within Vue components, encapsulating attributes such as name, type, and raw value. It provides getter and setter methods for these attributes and includes type constants for various data types.

classes.name: Prop
classes.description: A class representing a property for Vue components, supporting different data types and providing accessor methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the property.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the property.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the property.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the property.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value of the property, which can be of various data types.

methods.name: setRawValue
methods.description: Sets the raw value of the property.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON-encoded string representation of the raw value.
